textbookBox.concept: The Earth has a very long history of about 4.54 billion years, and humans occupy only a tiny, recent part of it. Several kinds of experts help us uncover the past.

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: The Earth has a very long history of about 4.54 billion years, and humans occupy only a tiny, recent part of it. Several kinds of experts help us uncover the past.
beats.speakEn: The Earth has a very long history of about 4.54 billion years, and humans occupy only a tiny, recent part of it. Several kinds of experts help us uncover the past.

beats.en: Every society has had its own way of measuring time. Big events, such as the birth of an important person or the start of a ruler reign, have often marked the beginning of a new era, which is a distinct period of time.
beats.speakEn: Every society has had its own way of measuring time. Big events, such as the birth of an important person or the start of a ruler reign, have often marked the beginning of a new era, which is a distinct period of time.

textbookBox.concept: A source of history is a place, person, text or object that gives information about a past event or period.

beats.en: A source of history is a place, person, text or object that gives information about a past event or period. Your family photos, diaries, ID cards and the memories of relatives are sources for your family history.
beats.speakEn: A source of history is a place, person, text or object that gives information about a past event or period. Your family photos, diaries, ID cards and the memories of relatives are sources for your family history.

beats.en: Modern humans, Homo sapiens, have walked the Earth for about 300000 years, which is a tiny part of the history of the Earth. Early humans faced many challenges from nature and lived in groups to help one another.
